meta.name: phase14_semantic_router_registry_contract
meta.note: Vocabulary + evidence contract for the Phase14 Hybrid (fast/slow) Semantic Router. Reuses the Phase13 canonical abstract 10-skill registry for routing ground truth, and ADDS the Phase13.5 route_mode / escalation contract.

escalation_contract.purpose: Hybrid router routes high-confidence/clear tasks on the fast path and escalates low-confidence/ambiguous/multi-intent/F3-F5 tasks to a semantic reader or planner. Benchmark measures BOTH semantic correctness AND escalation propriety (the gate must be selective, not a 100%-escalate loophole).
escalation_contract.provenance_rule: If route_mode==planner, the manifest MUST include an escalation_reason whose cited tokens are SUBSTRINGS present in the original task_text. An ungrounded/attractive reason (cited tokens not in the task) is treated as hallucinated evidence; validator must reject or dock evidence.
escalation_contract.efficiency_rule: Escalating a task labeled fast_path_ok (clear single-intent high-confidence) is WASTE. A router whose total escalation rate exceeds 0.55 across the pool, or that escalates >10% of the clear set, is penalized on the efficiency axis (anti-'escalate everything' guard).
escalation_contract.recovery_rule: escalation_reason must be compatible with escalation_reason_enum for consumers (loop_controller / evidence / recovery). retry budget = 2 still applies across escalated retries; low-confidence must trigger escalation-or-protection, never a crash.
